versions.content: Rational function The rational function is specified as rational coefficients for the numerator ( compuNumerator ) and the denominator ( compuDenominator ). CompuNominatorDenominator can have as many V elements as needed for the rational function. The sequence of the values V carries the information for the exponents, that means the first V is the coefficient for x0, the second V is the coefficient for x1, etc. With this sequence the values of the exponents can be entirely represented.
